title: Bitcoin whale transaction tracker from our own Bitcoin Core full node via ZMQ st
description: Bitcoin whale transaction tracker from our own Bitcoin Core full node via ZMQ stream. Filter by min BTC threshold, look back up to 168h. Returns transaction details (BTC/USD value, fee rate, size, ancestors/descendants, BIP125 RBF flag, confirmation status) plus aggregate summary. Proprietary ZMQ-connected pipeline — sub-second freshness. Informational research data only — not investment advice.
